PARTNER COMMUNITY: The world of rally and off-road for Assetto Corsa: cars, stages and servers, made by a team of enthusiasts and free for everyone.

RallyWorld and Gravel are a community that models and tunes its own rally and off-road cars for Assetto Corsa: the 3D, and the physics too, adjusted by hand. Everything is free: they run online events open to everyone and pay for their servers themselves.
They allowed us to use their cars in MWCoop, on one simple condition: respect their work and stay free. Thank you!
Rally, buggies, karts, UTVs, trophy trucks: a catalogue sorted by class.
Dirt and gravel layouts for every style.
Two online servers and free events, on the community's official time.
Drivers suited to each class (rally, kart, baja, UTV) and a dirt texture shared by their cars.
A small Spanish-speaking team, years of work
Everything is downloaded from their website and their Discord
Ported to My Winter Car and My Summer Car, with their agreement · your colour and your livery, like the other add-ons
The donations they receive pay for their servers and for free events. Your donation goes straight to them: MWCoop gets nothing.
Their rule: all their content is free and must never be sold. The RallyWorld cars in MWCoop stay free, for everyone.
